body: Type: Maintenance Affected Components: Computer, Website, API Jan 1, 00:00:00 GMT+0 - Identified - On Thursday, September 10 around 21:00 UTC (2:00 PM Pacific), we will migrate our status page from Instatus to incident.io as part of consolidating our incident response tooling. The switch is a DNS change, so it may take some time to complete for everyone. ## What is and isn't changing * The status page URL stays the same: . * Historical incidents have been migrated, so past incident history remains available on the new page. * Email subscribers will be migrated automatically. No action needed.…
